notes: The 1980 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: dedications and rededications, designs and architects' agreements, and the acquisition and design of the Central City (later Boeddeker) Park.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Chinese Pavilion lagoon (Richard Wong), Buena Vista Park erosion control (Eckbo-Kay), the zoo's Oceanside treatment plant landscape plans (EDAW).
coverage.note: Dated by footers and meeting reports. Curated list F1980.py.

findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission authorized taking Block 332, Lots 17, 18 and 19, beside the Downtown Bowl, by eminent domain for up to $370,000, as part of a new Central City Park; in December it appointed Royston, Hanamoto, Alley and Abey, landscape architects, to prepare the park's master plan, with the Downtown Bowl to be demolished after the new year.
